steps.name: InitCycle
steps.function: timer(trun := MUL_T_AI(SELF_ACT_PULSE,2 * SELF_ACT_CYCLES), toff := SELF_ACT_TIME, Test := TEST, ARE := ARE, arx := ARX); ARX := timer.ARX; ARO := timer.ARO; CYCLE_ELAPSED_TIME := CYCLE_ELAPSED_TIME + SCAN_TIME;

steps.name: SafetyCheckInput
steps.function: INPUT_VALID := (IN >= BYTE#0) AND (IN <= BYTE#255) AND (SENS > BYTE#0) AND (SENS <= BYTE#255); TIMEOUT_EXCEEDED := CYCLE_ELAPSED_TIME > MAX_SAFE_CYCLE_TIME;

steps.name: SafetyError
steps.function: OUT := FALSE; SAFETY_ERROR_FLAG := TRUE; ARO := FALSE;

steps.name: TimeoutSafeStop
steps.function: OUT := FALSE; TIMEOUT_ERROR_FLAG := TRUE; ARO := FALSE;

steps.name: Branch_0
steps.function: pwgen(PTL := SELF_ACT_PULSE, PTH := SELF_ACT_PULSE); out := pwgen.Q;

steps.name: Branch_1
steps.function: out := FALSE;

steps.name: Branch_2
steps.function: out := TRUE;

steps.name: Step_255
steps.function: pwgen.PTH := (CYCLE_TIME * BYTE_TO_TIME(BAND_B(IN,SENS)) ) / BYTE_TO_TIME(BYTE#255); pwgen.PTL := CYCLE_TIME - pwgen.PTH; pwgen(); out := pwgen.Q;

steps.name: ApplyOutput
steps.function: CYCLE_ELAPSED_TIME := TIME#0s;

transitions.guard: INPUT_VALID == TRUE AND TIMEOUT_EXCEEDED == FALSE AND aro == TRUE
INPUT_VALID == TRUE AND TIMEOUT_EXCEEDED == FALSE AND aro == FALSE AND in<sens
INPUT_VALID == TRUE AND TIMEOUT_EXCEEDED == FALSE AND aro == FALSE AND NOT (in<sens) AND BYTE_TO_USINT(in)>USINT#255-BYTE_TO_USINT(sens)
INPUT_VALID == TRUE AND TIMEOUT_EXCEEDED == FALSE AND aro == FALSE AND NOT (in<sens) AND NOT (BYTE_TO_USINT(in)>USINT#255-BYTE_TO_USINT(sens))

nl_prompt:
When: Safety-critical input `SENS` becomes zero or invalid, causing a potential division by zero in Step_255.
Action: Add a dedicated `ValidateSensInput` step after `SafetyCheckInput` to check `SENS > 0`. On failure, transition to a new `SensSafetyError` step that sets outputs to a safe state and logs the fault.

steps.name: InitCycle
steps.function: timer(trun := MUL_T_AI(SELF_ACT_PULSE,2 * SELF_ACT_CYCLES), toff := SELF_ACT_TIME, Test := TEST, ARE := ARE, arx := ARX); ARX := timer.ARX; ARO := timer.ARO; CYCLE_ELAPSED_TIME := CYCLE_ELAPSED_TIME + SCAN_TIME;

steps.name: SafetyCheckInput
steps.function: INPUT_VALID := (IN >= BYTE#0) AND (IN <= BYTE#255) AND (SENS > BYTE#0) AND (SENS <= BYTE#255); TIMEOUT_EXCEEDED := CYCLE_ELAPSED_TIME > MAX_SAFE_CYCLE_TIME;

steps.name: ValidateSensInput
steps.function: SENS_VALID := (SENS > BYTE#0);

steps.name: SensSafetyError
steps.function: OUT := FALSE; SAFETY_ERROR_FLAG := TRUE; ARO := FALSE; SENS_ERROR_FLAG := TRUE;

steps.function: OUT := FALSE; TIMEOUT_ERROR_FLAG := TRUE; ARO := FALSE;

steps.name: Branch_0
steps.function: pwgen(PTL := SELF_ACT_PULSE, PTH := SELF_ACT_PULSE); out := pwgen.Q;

steps.name: WatchdogCheck_0
steps.function: PWGEN_VALID_0 := (pwgen.Q = TRUE) OR (pwgen.Q = FALSE);

steps.name: WatchdogError
steps.function: OUT := FALSE; WATCHDOG_ERROR_FLAG := TRUE; ARO := FALSE;

steps.name: Branch_1
steps.function: out := FALSE;

steps.name: Branch_2
steps.function: out := TRUE;

steps.name: WatchdogCheck_255
steps.function: PWGEN_VALID_255 := (pwgen.Q = TRUE) OR (pwgen.Q = FALSE);

steps.name: ApplyOutput
steps.function: CYCLE_ELAPSED_TIME := TIME#0s;

transitions.guard: SENS_VALID == TRUE AND aro == FALSE AND in<sens
SENS_VALID == TRUE AND aro == FALSE AND NOT (in<sens) AND BYTE_TO_USINT(in)>USINT#255-BYTE_TO_USINT(sens)
SENS_VALID == TRUE AND aro == FALSE AND NOT (in<sens) AND NOT (BYTE_TO_USINT(in)>USINT#255-BYTE_TO_USINT(sens))
